purpose: Teach: 池上/浅井/塩野/大村/亀山/成瀬/中沢/川村

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、池上刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: The police—Detective Ikegami's response at the scene was evaluated highly, wasn't it?
lines.style: Light, conversational acknowledgment. Smooth pacing, almost thinking aloud. A gentle upward inflection on the tag question, inviting agreement rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人浅井氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police will be interviewing the witness, Mr. Asai, carefully about the details, won't they?
lines.style: Steady, methodical tone. Even pacing, slightly formal register. Matter-of-fact, noting procedure as a reasonable step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者塩野氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And they'll be mindful of the victim Mr. Shiono's family throughout all of this, I'm sure.
lines.style: Gentle, compassionate undertone. Slower pace on the name. Reassuring—not lecturing, but affirming that care is understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者大村氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: They'll be collecting and organizing the witness testimony from Mr. Oomura carefully.
lines.style: Factual, attentive tone. Clear articulation. Steady tempo, as if running through a checklist with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者亀山の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And they'll confirm the suspect Kameyama's criminal history as part of the investigation.
lines.style: Brisk, professional delivery. Crisp consonants on 'confirm.' No hesitation—this is standard procedure being named.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識成瀬主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: The forensics chief Naruse and the investigators will conduct a thorough scene examination together.
lines.style: Technical but warm. Slight pause before the name to ground it. Even, professional pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士中沢様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: They'll also be consulting with the psychologist, Ms. Nakazawa, for her expert insight.
lines.style: Respectful, acknowledging expertise. Measured pace. Light emphasis on 'consulting,' showing deference to her role.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の川村様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And the prosecutor, Mr. Kawamura, will meet with them for the pre-trial conference.
lines.style: Warmer, slightly more personal than the previous lines. Less formality creeping in. Natural, conversational rhythm.
